name: Pending Items by Project
query:
SELECT
	po.supplier AS "Supplier:Link/Supplier:180",
	poi.parent AS "Purchase Order:Link/Purchase Order:140",
	poi.item_code AS "Item:Link/Item:170",
	poi.item_name AS "Item Name:Data:280",
	poi.schedule_date AS "Expected Delivery:Date:130",
	poi.qty AS "Ordered Qty:Float:110",
	ifnull(poi.received_qty, 0) AS "Received Qty:Float:110",
	poi.qty - ifnull(poi.received_qty, 0) AS "Pending Qty:Float:110",
	poi.uom AS "UOM:Link/UOM:90",
	po.status AS "PO Status:Data:150"
FROM `tabPurchase Order Item` poi
INNER JOIN `tabPurchase Order` po ON po.name = poi.parent
WHERE po.docstatus = 1
	AND po.per_received < 100
	AND po.status NOT IN ('Closed', 'Delivered')
	AND poi.qty - ifnull(poi.received_qty, 0) > 0
	AND ifnull(nullif(poi.project, ''), po.project) = %(project)s
ORDER BY poi.schedule_date ASC, po.supplier ASC, poi.parent ASC, poi.idx ASC
